title: Consolidation: stop historical status sections from claiming to be current (no new kappa)
body:
**Card:** `scope-navigation` (consolidation track, chooser seed `ef0afbea84ae0155fdc123ffbb7a0329`, base `49b3157d`). Scope unchanged. No new κ.

## The confusing path
`docs/research/current-status.md` is linked from CONTRIBUTING and autoresearch as the place to read the current result. Below its real top section, it contains:
- two more `# Current reviewed status` headings, under the #1042 snapshot (κ 0.001672188…) and the #942 snapshot (κ 0.001661960…);
- `# Selected construction: …` (κ 0.00066, #186);
- `# Current contracts and research status` (2^-30, October 8), with `## Current and earlier results`, `## Exact current parameters and bottleneck` and `## Next research priority`. That last one says the next improvement "should target the bit finite network", but today the **complex** side binds.

A reader or agent that searches or jumps by heading can land on any of these. Several research notes already warn that historical notes say "current" for obsolete checkpoints; this page is the most-linked instance.

## Change
- These seven headings are renamed to name their checkpoint (for example `## Reviewed status at the #1042 checkpoint` and `## Research priority at the 2^-31 integration (superseded; see autoresearch.md)`).
- One banner is added where the history begins. It says that "current/selected/latest/next" inside historical sections refer to their own checkpoint, and points to `selected-result.json` and `autoresearch.md`.
- **No section body is changed**, so the history is preserved verbatim.
- New `tests/test_research_current_status.py`:
  - only the first heading may say current, selected or next research;
  - the top section must contain the selected record's `decimal`, review filename and `reproduce` command;
  - the banner must be present.

  The test **fails on main's text** (2 failures) and passes with this change. When the status page is next updated, the previous top heading must be demoted, which is exactly the step that was missed.

## Checks
- `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'`: 23 OK, 1 skipped.
- No links to the renamed anchors exist in the repository.
- Three packages pin `current-status.md` (`u8-terminal-cone-census`, `e8-joint-reader-bound`, `r480-quad12-exact-seed12`). All pin older blobs as historical provenance, none of which match current main, so no live pin changes.
- Overlap: `find_overlap.py 'current-status' 'current reviewed status' 'navigation'` found no open PR or discussion on this page. Open PR file lists were not searched exhaustively.

**Feedback:** this is from the same contributor as #1228 and #1231. The friction from the first session was that "current" appears in many superseded headings.
